sourceFacts: Exact wrapper props/slots/native output from sources/react-api-inventory.json and pinned code.
contentAlternative: Native kbd text describes the key/shortcut in surrounding task text. Symbols need a spoken text explanation when ambiguous.
updatesAndDescendants: Kbd and KbdGroup render native kbd elements and do not register shortcuts, move focus or handle key events. Changing children changes the notation only.
referenceDecision: The Ctrl+S notation is an example, not a newly registered shortcut. KbdGroup is typed with div props upstream but actually renders kbd; this known source distinction is retained.
keyboard: This default content wrapper does not install a keyboard listener or roving focus. Native links/buttons/inputs in the chosen children retain their own documented semantics. Label delegates native focus through its associated control.
naming: The HTML projection identifies all required visible content/labels. No unnecessary ARIA role/name is imposed on native text, headings, kbd or tables.

key.description: Native keyboard-input notation, not shortcut registration.

group.description: Native kbd grouping of the notation.
